pf.overview.title: One fleet, one discipline
pf.lede: A unified, evidence-based portfolio of the Helix family, vasic-digital utilities, and the Server Factory toolchain.
pf.summary: One fleet: large product applications on top of dozens of small, decoupled, independently-tested modules — governed by a shared engineering Constitution and verified by anti-bluff QA. The dominant language is Go, with Kotlin/KMP, TypeScript/React, Python, Swift, and Shell where they fit best. The unifying thesis: a feature is done only when a real user can use it and there is captured evidence to prove it.
